# Minimal project

A synthetic project for project-atlas tests, the English twin of
`test/fixtures/minimal`: two decisions, one history record, two rules and
one role. Not a sentence of it comes from a real project.

The first decision is `docs/adr/2026-01-10-0900-plain-storage.md`, the
current one is ADR `2026-01-15-1000`. Changes are checked by `reviewer`,
and the ground rule is I-1.
